name: Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your back flat.
Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg up until your thigh is in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your lower back. Complete all reps, then switch.
